tasks.title: Airbrake start distance
tasks.solution: stop_distance = V²/(2·Q_TRANS_DECEL) + 2·V: the stopping distance plus two seconds for the VTOL motors to spin up. SITL: 19.2 m/s, 2 m/s² → 92.2 + 38.4 = 130.6 m, and the log has "VTOL airbrake v=19.2 d=130 sd=130".

tasks.title: Forward transition distance (lower bound)
tasks.solution: The threshold is max(AIRSPEED_MIN, Q_ASSIST_SPEED): while the airspeed is below Q_ASSIST_SPEED, Q-assist keeps the state in AIRSPEED_WAIT. Acceleration takes V²/(2a), then the timer T = Q_TRANSITION_MS runs at no less than the threshold speed: d ≥ V²/(2a) + V·T. SITL: 18 m/s, 5 m/s², 5 s → 122 m (159 m in reality, since the vehicle kept accelerating).

tasks.title: The "VTOL land too short" check
tasks.solution: AP_Arming_Plane: min = 0.75 · stopping_distance(V²) = 0.75 · V²/(2·Q_TRANS_DECEL), V = TECS_LAND_ARSPD or, if that is not set, AIRSPEED_CRUISE. SITL: 25 m/s, 2 m/s² → 117 m.

tasks.title: Choosing Q_ASSIST_SPEED
tasks.solution: Q_ASSIST_SPEED = max(AIRSPEED_MIN − 3, V_s). It must not be above AIRSPEED_MIN: CRUISE and FBWB at zero throttle hold AIRSPEED_MIN, and assistance would cycle on and off as in step 2 of the practice.

tasks.title: QRTL climb altitude near home
tasks.solution: The return radius R = 1.5·max(WP_LOITER_RAD, RTL_RADIUS); the target = max(Q_RTL_ALT·d/max(R, d), Q_RTL_ALT_MIN constrained to the range Q_LAND_FINAL_ALT…Q_RTL_ALT). The module's example: 60 m → R = 90 m; d = 50 m → max(8.3, 10) = 10 m.
